observations.original: The existing inlet reads as a pale box, dark front panel, three thin guards, and yellow lower ledge. The large pale upper slab is visually flat and makes the intake less purposeful. Native collection is seven meshes plus root, mostly cuboid geometry with three guard owners and a mouth animation owner.
observations.target: The fixed target adds a deep open pale cyan funnel, a thick rolled rim, softly rounded shell and yellow plinth, a dark recessed mouth housing, three thick rounded guards, and sparse metal fasteners. Large joined forms carry the design; bevel highlights and a few broad fasteners can survive intended scale.
observations.style: Warm sculpted toy-like materials, broad highlights and gentle volume separation. Preserve pale cyan/silver, charcoal and golden yellow identity. A symmetrical light setup should show this from all four capture directions.
observations.constructionPlan: Rebuild as a genuine hollow tapered inlet with thick rim and recessed front grille, a low rounded yellow shoe and purposeful rear seating neck. Keep mouth pulse and guard rocking as native one-second actions, improving perceptibility within reserve. Measure attachment on actual frozen front face before choosing rear neck geometry.
observations.risks: Target is front-biased; rear view needs purposeful attachment construction and unobtrusive visible functional motion. The actual neutral reserve is shallower and lower than old source. Finite lamp and body clearance require measured native geometry rather than inferred overlap.
